prose: Business Insider reports Cognition, the AI coding startup behind Devin, is weighing a new funding round before year's end after receiving offers valuing it at $70 to $80 billion - weeks after announcing a round at $48 billion in September.
highlights: Up from $48B just weeks ago in September
